description: Use when the user asks who else competes in a company's market, or wants a peer/competitor set for a given company. Given a company domain or name, returns the other companies IndustryLens tracks in the same market. Returns { covered: false } for companies not publicly tracked.

domain.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred.

name.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

name: find_competitors
title: Find who competes with a company
